purpose: Manual corrections. update_devices.py merges these LAST, so an entry here always beats the automated source. Never hand-edit devices.json - fix it here instead. Format documented in PIPELINE-OPS.md.

overrides.market: Global security scope; Swiss B2B corroboration
overrides.source_note: Samsung's live security scope still lists Galaxy Z Fold3 5G for quarterly updates on 2026-08-30. A Samsung B2B lifecycle document dated 2024 publishes its SMR End as 2026-08; the dataset normalizes that manufacturer-published month to its final day, 2026-08-31. The device is supported on 2026-08-30 and becomes ended on 2026-09-01.
overrides.reason: Preserve the device when endoflife.date supplies no dated security EOL, using Samsung's live scope as the primary source and its published SMR end month as corroboration.
